title: Vaccination impact summary (real CC-BY prose from Our World in Data)

source.attribution: Our World in Data (Roser, Ritchie, Dattani), CC-BY-4.0
source.notes: Composed from real Our World in Data / Shattock et al. vaccination figures (CC-BY): over 80% infant coverage (one in five uncovered); ~154 million deaths prevented over fifty years. Clean version verified internally consistent (100 - 80 = 20; 154M/50 ~= 3M/yr; 3M/365 ~= 8,000/day) before injecting 3 defects findable from the text's own numbers.
